description: This chart illustrates the distribution of responses categorized as “Deceived,” “Partially,” and “Not Deceived” across two levels of ambiguity, labeled “Ambiguity 1 (Outer)” and “Ambiguity 2 (Inner).” The chart consists of six slices, representing the three categories for each ambiguity level. For Ambiguity 1 (Outer), the “Deceived” category is represented by a red slice occupying approximately 57.9% of the circle, followed by the yellow “Partially” slice at 23.5%, and the green “Not Deceived” slice at 10.5%. For Ambiguity 2 (Inner), the “Deceived” category is represented by a red slice occupying approximately 67.6% of the circle, followed by the yellow “Partially” slice at 8.8%, and the green “Not Deceived” slice at 10.5%. A legend is provided, labeling each color with its corresponding category for both ambiguity levels, and percentage labels are displayed within each slice. The slices appear ordered by decreasing proportion within each ambiguity ring.
